name: select
title: Select
summary: Pick one value from a list that opens from a field.
description: Pick one value from a list. A field-style trigger opens a raised popup that scales out of the trigger; a single highlight glides between options under the pointer and the arrow keys alike; opening from the keyboard and the caret stay instant. Behaviour, focus and ARIA come from the Zag select machine, through Ark UI in React, Vue and Svelte.

anatomy.description: Caret; flips while open. Carries kbd-instant: instant when the popup opens from the keyboard
Placed by the engine; rendered in a portal so cards cannot clip it. Exposes --transform-origin, --reference-width, --available-height

role=listbox popup; the shared popup surface (`lib/popup.ts`: surface, motion, keyboard-instant; stacking from base.css). data-state=open|closed; sizes xs and sm: 26px rows (--option-height). Width: never narrower than the trigger (or 120px), then as wide as its longest option, up to 360px
Shared gliding highlight layer (`glideLayer` of `lib/glide.ts`); glides under the pointer and the keyboard
the shared option row's group label (`lib/option.ts`)
role=option; data-highlighted, data-state=checked|unchecked, data-disabled; composes the shared option row (`lib/option.ts`: 30px, text.dense (12.5px), gap 8)
The shared option row's text (`lib/option.ts`). Never cut with an ellipsis: an option longer than the popup's 360px cap wraps
Trailing muted note (e.g. a model tier); the shared option row's meta (`lib/option.ts`)
Check on the selected option, shown through the item's data-state; keeps its space on other rows so trailing notes stay aligned; the shared option row's indicator (`lib/option.ts`)

items.description: Options in order. Strings are accepted as value=label.

size.description: The shared control's sizes (`lib/control.ts`), dimensions only: xs 24px, sm 28px, md 32px, lg 36px. Up to 28px the list's rows are 26px.

variant.description: The shared control's looks (`lib/control.ts`), at every size. outline: the form field (field colour, hairline). subtle: the inspector (inset grey, no edge). ghost: reads as text until touched (the model picker); open, it keeps the darker fill an open ghost button keeps, with no ring or field fill. With no width it is as wide as its value, the caret right after it; given a width (a property row in a side panel) it fills it and the caret sits at the end, as the ghost combobox's does.

name.description: Form field name; renders a hidden native select.

placement.description: Preferred side; flips when there is no room.

events.ui:set-value: No adapter handles it (control `value` instead). { value: string | null }
events.ui:set-open: No adapter handles it. { open: boolean }

keyboard: Enter / Space / ArrowDown / ArrowUp on the trigger open the list
ArrowDown / ArrowUp move the highlight; Home / End jump
Typing jumps to the matching option (type-ahead), open or closed
Enter / Space select and close; Escape closes; focus returns to the trigger
notes: Give it a visible label or an aria-label.
Opening and closing from the keyboard are instant; the pointer gets the scale-in. The highlight glides for the pointer and the arrow keys alike.
Every option is readable in full: the list grows to its longest option and wraps anything longer than its cap. The trigger shows one line and may shorten the selected label; the list shows it whole.

motion: popup: the shared popup surface (`lib/popup.ts`): opacity + scale from motion.popup-scale out of the trigger (--transform-origin), along the block axis only (the list is as wide as the trigger, and its sides stay on the trigger's sides however wide it is), duration.popup, easing.out-strong; closes at duration.fast; instant when opened or closed from the keyboard
caret: rotate 180deg over duration.move, easing.out-strong; instant from the keyboard
highlight: one layer glides between options over duration.move, easing.out-strong, under the pointer and the arrow keys alike
rows: a pressed option darkens to color.hover-2 over duration.fast
trigger: colour and ring over duration.fast / duration.base; the shared control's motion (`lib/control.ts`): press darkens, in every look; a trigger never scales
